solves.reasoning: ③hold: Q1 markers=['using', 'advanced', 'hold', 'supposed'] — ③hold: 'The argument hold that' → 주어 The argument(단수)에 holds가 필요. hold는 틀림. ①using, ②advanced, ④supposed는 적절.
②bringing: Q2 markers=['functions', 'bringing', 'artisan', 'conclude'] — ②bringing: 'to help bringing to life' → help+목적어+원형. bringing이 아닌 bring이 필요. ①functions, ③artisan, ④conclude는 적절.
②that: Q3 markers=['illustrate', 'that', 'implies', 'has'] — ②that: 'they serve simply that illustrate' → to illustrate가 필요. that이 접속사로 맞지 않음. ①illustrate, ③implies, ④has는 적절.
④what: Q4 markers=['seems', 'image', 'meant', 'what'] — ④what: 'supposed to show what we should conclude' → why(이유)가 필요. what은 맥락상 틀림. ①seems, ②image, ③meant는 적절.

④refuse: Q6 markers=['implies', 'meant', 'show', 'refuse'] — ④refuse: 'the analogy is supposed to refuse why we should conclude' → 원문은 show. refuse(거부)는 반대. ①implies, ②meant, ③show는 적절.

②trivial: Q7 markers=['illustrate', 'trivial', 'thinkers', 'creator'] — ②trivial: 'the analogy can be a trivial part of an argument' → 원문은 integral(핵심적인). trivial(사소한)은 반대. ①illustrate, ③thinkers, ④creator는 적절.

②undermined: Q8 markers=['functions', 'undermined', 'illustrate', 'creator'] — ②undermined: 'which has been undermined by many thinkers' → 원문은 advanced. undermined(약화됨)는 반대. ①functions, ③illustrate, ④creator는 적절.

③obscures: Q9 markers=['compares', 'popular', 'obscures', 'conclude'] — ③obscures: 'the analogy is supposed to obscures why we should conclude' → 원문은 show. obscures(흐리게 하다)는 반대. ①compares, ②popular, ④conclude는 적절.

'On other occasions, however, ____' — 단순 설명이 아닌 논증의 핵심. 'the analogy can be an integral part of an argument'(④)이 원문. analogies serve no purpose(①), comparison becomes decorative(②), philosophers reject all forms(③)는 반대.

'just as an artefact such as a watch implies the existence of an artisan, ____' → 유추 결론: 'so the universe implies the existence of a divine creator'(①). sun serves as symbol(②), analogies should never be used(③), Paley was greatest(④)는 부적합.

'the analogy is supposed to show ____' → 원문 'why we should conclude that the universe has a creator'(③). watches are more complex(①), ancient philosophers' view(②), Plato and Paley shared identical beliefs(④)는 부적합.

유추가 단순 설명과 논증의 핵심 두 가지 기능을 함. 'the dual roles of analogies in philosophical reasoning'(①). history of religious arguments(②), Socrates preferred sun(③), scientific evidence for divine creator(④)는 부분적.
'artefact such as a watch implies the existence of an artisan' — 시계라는 인공물이 존재하면 장인이 있음을 암시. '정교하게 설계된 물건이 존재하면 그것을 만든 설계자가 반드시 있다'(①). 장인 독립적 증명(②), 시계 자연발생(③), 고대 기술 우수(④)는 부적합.

'the analogy with the watch is not meant simply to illustrate a point. Rather, the analogy is supposed to show why we should conclude...' — 여기서 this analogy(지칭)는 시계와 장인-우주와 창조자 유추. '시계와 장인의 관계를 우주와 창조자에 적용한 유추'(②).

solves.reasoning: 도입: 'Analogies can serve two different functions' → (C) 단순 illustrate 설명(소크라테스 태양 예시) → (B) On other occasions, however, integral part — 설계 논증 소개 → (A) The argument holds...watch implies artisan, universe implies creator. 순서: (C)-(B)-(A)=③.
④'설계 논증에서 시계 유추는 오직 요점을 설명하기 위한 목적으로만 쓰인다' → FALSE. 본문: 'the analogy with the watch is not meant simply to illustrate a point'. 단순 설명이 아님. ①②③는 본문과 일치.
